name: Pörnbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and light blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Pörnbach (a blue wavy bar between roses and a hunting horn on white).
history: Municipal flag of Pörnbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Pörnbach arms — wavy bar, roses and horn
